authority.method: certified dyadic interval greedy replay, rigorous finite-rank tail bounds, exact target binary digits, exact divisor convolution, and exhaustive eligible weak-divisor edges

finite_interpretation: The +1 shift is selected before seeing the census because Q+1 is the native normalized carry in the checked membership theorems.  Zero finite violations would open a broader survivor-genealogy mechanism; any violation is an exact falsifier.

multiplicative_running_max_candidate.definition: H(m)=1+max_{0<=k<m} Q_k, so a strict record n has H(n+1)=Q_n+1 and a weak record r has H(r+1)=Q_r+1
multiplicative_running_max_candidate.direct_all_depth_consequence_if_proved: Fix any base d with H(d)>=2.  For N+1>d, take q=ceil((N+1)/d).  Monotonicity of H and PMRMH give Q_N+1<=H(q*d)<=q*H(d)=O(N).  Thus PMRMH for the actual 1/21 carry is itself a global linear-defect producer and needs neither record genealogy nor a phase-lock theorem.

exact_representation_falsifier.classification: PMRMH is neither support-universal nor implied by exact greedy representability; an all-depth proof for 1/21 must use additional arithmetic of that actual orbit
exact_representation_falsifier.tail_identity_used: Q_k=floor(T_k), where T_k=sum_{d in A} 2^(k mod d)/(2^d-1), for an exactly represented target

multiplicative_running_max_candidate.implication: At a strict-record/weak-record successor-divisor edge, set d=r+1 and q*d=n+1; MRMH then gives SEWGN immediately.

positive_base_subcandidate.direct_consequence: At any one fixed positive base, PMRMH bounds every later rank after rounding its horizon up to a multiple of that base; the edge implication is not needed for this stronger use.
positive_base_subcandidate.implication: Every weak record in the genealogy has positive defect, so its successor d satisfies H(d)=Q_r+1>=2.  PMRMH therefore implies SEWGN on every eligible edge.
positive_base_subcandidate.statement: H(q*d) <= q*H(d) for every tested q>=2

multiplicative_running_max_candidate.selectivity_conclusion: The positive-base law is not a consequence of Boolean support, infinite support, exact representation, or exact greedy replay.  Its zero failures in the bounded rational cohort and on 1/21 therefore measure target-specific arithmetic rather than a universal tail identity.
multiplicative_running_max_candidate.statement: H(q*d) <= q*H(d) for every integer q>=2 and every tested horizon d with q*d at most the rank cap plus one
multiplicative_running_max_candidate.unrestricted_falsifier_classification: Every unrestricted violation has H(d)=1, q=2, and margin -1; these occur before a positive weak-record plateau.

nonclaims: The finite alive cohort does not prove survival beyond the cap.
The census does not prove SWGN or SEWGN at all depths.
The census does not prove the multiplicative envelope MRMH.
The census does not prove weak-parent existence at all depths.
The census does not prove the second-record fixed-anchor law.
The census does not prove 1/21 membership or decide Erdos 257.

raw_normalized_candidate.statement: Q_n/(n+1) <= Q_r/(r+1) on a chosen weak-divisor edge

second_record_fixed_anchor_control.interpretation: This preselected fixed-anchor law is stronger than merely having some weak divisor parent and is tested cross-target to measure source specificity.
second_record_fixed_anchor_control.statement: The successor of the second strict record divides every later strict-record successor.

shifted_edgewise_candidate.statement: (Q_n+1)/(n+1) <= (Q_r+1)/(r+1) on every eligible strict-record/weak-record successor-divisor edge

shifted_normalized_candidate.statement: (Q_n+1)/(n+1) <= (Q_r+1)/(r+1) on the largest eligible weak-divisor edge

weak_parent_existence_control.interpretation: Parent existence is a logically separate clause; the density inequality is tested only when an edge exists.
